body_markdown:
# Data Stewardship

## Definition

Data Stewardship is the operational care for data on behalf of its owner — maintaining definitions, [[Metadata|metadata]], [[Data Quality|quality]] rules and issue resolution.

## Explanation

Stewards turn owner decisions into maintained reality: they propose definitions, monitor quality, triage issues and coordinate with custodians. Stewardship without [[Data Ownership|ownership]] lacks authority; ownership without stewardship lacks execution.

## Distinctions

- Business stewardship (meaning, rules) vs technical stewardship (structures, pipelines) — some organisations split the role.

## Examples

- A steward maintains the rule "policy end date ≥ policy start date" and follows up violations.
